hero.body: A sacred Hindu temple and heritage centre in Norval, Halton Hills — a place to worship, celebrate festivals, and keep Sanatan Dharma alive for families across the GTA.
hero.imageAlt: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre temple grounds in Norval, Ontario

about.title: Hindu temple in Norval, Ontario
about.p1: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre is a Hindu temple and cultural home in Norval, Halton Hills. Dedicated to Shri Radha Sarveshwar, we welcome devotees from across the Greater Toronto Area for worship, festivals, and community.
about.p2: Our purpose is to preserve and share Sanatan Dharma — a place where families can gather, children can grow in culture, and visitors can find peace.
about.imageAlt: Radha Sarveshwar Heritage Centre temple hall interior

festivals.title: Festivals at RSHC
festivals.body: Join us through the year for the sacred Hindu calendar in Norval. Call or email for the next utsav date.
